{{Top}}
'''Andris''',<ref name="AJ2" /> also known as '''white spice''',<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> was the most common [[Spice/Legends|spice]] variant. [[Mining/Legends|Mined]] on [[Sevarcos II]]<ref name="AJ2" />, [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]<ref name="YJKCaCR">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Crisis at Crystal Reef]]''</ref>, and the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Empress Teta system]],<ref name="TEA" /> it was commonly added to food, both for its properties of enhancing flavor and preventing spoilage,<ref name="guide" /> the latter of which made it especially valuable on extremely slow [[Starship/Legends|starships]] early in the days of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] travel.<ref name="AJ2">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref>

Raw andris, when mined, was tan and crumbly, and was originally used in this form; however, it was later learned that it could be refined to a white [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] form that also provided a slight sensory enhancement to its users by using powerful electrical charges.<ref name="AJ2" /> It had the property to increase efficiency and fire rate of neural cells, offering, as a result, a stimulating effect.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Andris could be further refined into an addictive stimulant form that provided for even stronger sensory enhancement, a more intense sensory experience and perception. Deep freezing also greatly enhanced its properties.<ref name="guide" /><ref name="AJ2" /> 

While raw and refined, andris was legal under both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the highly-refined variety was not. Both [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] and the [[Imperial Board of Foodstuffs and Consumables]] praised andris, and the Imperial military allowed its use by its soldiers; it was believed by some that this marked an attempt by the Empire to drug the Galaxy into submission.<ref name="AJ2" />

While one [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Imperial credit]] bought a dose (typically ten [[gram]]s), the illegal processed andris costed 500 credits in the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="guide" />
